title: Choose the Contact page composition
question: All three keep the Activity Ledger identity, the same three-field task, and the same Resend flow. Choose the structure that should carry the conversation.

options.label: Registered Dispatch
options.thesis: A message becomes a traceable dispatch assembled in public, then resolves into a delivery receipt.
options.viewport: A broad dispatch docket spans the first viewport: three numbered entry bands on the left, a fixed delivery register to marc@mansour.contact on the right, and a send control embedded in the detachable receipt strip.
options.risk: The postal metaphor must stay subordinate to fast form completion.

options.label: Correspondence Desk
options.lineage: clipped working letter beside an analyst's index
options.thesis: The invitation and the message sheet share one desk, making the human exchange immediate and calm.
options.viewport: A large left-hand invitation and compact contact facts balance a clipped three-field letter sheet on the right; successful submission replaces the sheet with a filed confirmation slip.
options.risk: The familiar split composition could feel conventional if the paper object lacks physical conviction.

options.label: Three-Line Ledger
options.lineage: full-width accounting folio with ruled entry rows
options.thesis: Name, address, and message become the only three entries in an oversized public ledger.
options.viewport: The page is one edge-to-edge form table: two concise rows for identity, one expansive writing row, and a final action register that shows recipient, privacy, and submission state without a separate card.
options.risk: The extreme flatness demands immaculate spacing and focus treatment to remain inviting.
